amendments.body: The patch does not implement `tanksim-6e5.5.7`. All substantive edits are alkalinity-accounting work in `crates/tank_core/src/systems/nitrogen_cycle.rs:12-385`, `crates/tank_core/src/types/budget.rs:67-124`, `crates/tank_core/src/budget_helpers.rs:64-640`, and the new `crates/tank_core/tests/nitrification_alkalinity.rs:1-336`. None of the requested habitat/geometry deliverables are added: there are no probes for biofilter scaling, light-depth, habitat-specific fouling, substrate redox, or equipment scaling, and there is no habitat/geometry e2e harness/report change under the scenario/harness crates. Closing the bead with this patch would leave the requested regression coverage absent.
amendments.rationale: This is the core deliverable mismatch for the task: the code under review is testing and implementing a different feature than the one the bead is supposed to land.

amendments.body: The only new regression file, `crates/tank_core/tests/nitrification_alkalinity.rs:1-336`, is currently untracked, while the tracked diff only contains the production edits in `crates/tank_core/src/budget_helpers.rs:64-640`, `crates/tank_core/src/engine.rs:224-279`, `crates/tank_core/src/systems/nitrogen_cycle.rs:12-385`, `crates/tank_core/src/systems/water_change.rs:99-153`, `crates/tank_core/src/types/budget.rs:67-124`, `crates/tank_core/src/types/mod.rs:43-46`, and `crates/tank_core/src/types/process.rs:6-27,335-338`. The local `cargo test` run passes because that file exists in the working tree, but it would not ship in the actual patch unless it is added, leaving the new alkalinity accounting changes without their intended coverage.
amendments.rationale: This is a delivery blocker: the tests that are supposed to justify the behavior change are not part of the tracked patch.

amendments.body: The new trace field `nitrogen_cycle.total_n_nitrified_mg` is internally inconsistent. `crates/tank_core/src/systems/nitrogen_cycle.rs:13-23` describes the output as total nitrified N, and `crates/tank_core/src/engine.rs:229-239` emits it as a debugging note, but the implementation at `crates/tank_core/src/systems/nitrogen_cycle.rs:343-346` only sums `nob_step.oxidized_n_mg + comammox_step.oxidized_n_mg`. In any tick where AOB converts TAN to nitrite faster than NOB clears nitrite, the trace will report too little nitrification while `alkalinity_consumed_meq` at `crates/tank_core/src/systems/nitrogen_cycle.rs:366-384` still reflects `aob + comammox`. That makes the new scientific diagnostics misleading exactly in the NOB-limited cases they are meant to help debug.
amendments.rationale: This does not break the state update, but it does make the new tracing output scientifically wrong and therefore unreliable for debugging and regression analysis.

payload.summary: I reviewed the modified `tank_core` files end-to-end and ran targeted `cargo test -p tank_core --test nitrification_alkalinity`, `--test water_change_mass_balance`, `--test budget_tracking`, `--test chemistry`, and `--test cycling`; those suites passed locally. I still found three blocking review items: the patch is not implementing the habitat/geometry scenario-test bead it is attached to, the only new regression file is currently untracked, and the new nitrification trace metric under-reports AOB-driven nitrification when nitrite accumulates.
